product_overview: The Pharmacy Warehouse Management System (WMS) digitizes inventory operations for the Faculty of Pharmacy at October 6 University. It centralizes authentication, product catalog management, warehouse stock movements, expiry change approvals, and audit logging while supporting secure, role-based access.
core_goals: Replace manual paper-based warehouse logs with a secure digital system
Support role-based authentication and authorization for Admin and Storekeeper users
Manage chemical, reagent, and apparatus catalogs with controlled CRUD operations
Track warehouse stock movements including receipts, dispatches, and disposals
Enforce FEFO stock rotation when issuing chemicals
Provide an approval workflow for batch expiry date change requests
Maintain searchable security audit logs for traceability and review

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Allows users to sign in securely and supports creation of system users with role-based access control.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> Use JWT token for subsequent authenticated requests
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized with no token issued
POST /api/auth/register/admin with valid request body -> Receive 200 OK for new system user
POST /api/auth/register/admin with duplicate email -> Receive 409 Conflict

features.name: Products Management API
features.description: Manages the product catalog for chemicals and reagents, including retrieval, creation, updates, and deletion of catalog items.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/products with token -> Receive 200 with product list
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/products with valid product data -> Receive 201 Created

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/products/{id} with existing ID -> Receive 200 with product details -> PUT /api/products/{id} with updated data -> Receive 200 OK
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> DELETE /api/products/{id} with existing ID -> Receive 204 No Content
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/products/{id} with non-existent ID -> Receive 404 Not Found
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/products with invalid payload -> Receive 400 Bad Request

features.name: Warehouse Stock Movements API
features.description: Records warehouse ledger actions for receipts, dispatches, and disposals, supporting stock movement tracking and FEFO-based issuance behavior.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/orders with a valid receipt voucher payload -> Receive 201 Created
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/orders with token -> Receive 200 with stock movement list
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/orders/{id} with existing movement ID -> Receive 200 with movement details

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/orders with a valid dispatch voucher payload -> Receive 201 Created after FEFO allocation from earliest-expiring batches
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/orders with a dispatch quantity greater than available stock -> Receive 400 Bad Request or 409 Conflict
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/orders with an invalid disposal payload -> Receive 400 Bad Request

features.name: Expiry Change Requests Approval API
features.description: Supports submission and review of batch expiry modification requests, including manager approval and rejection actions.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/approvals with a batch expiry change request, new date, and justification -> Receive 201 Created with Pending status
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/approvals/my -> Receive 200 with the current user's submitted requests
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/approvals/pending -> Receive 200 with pending requests
POST /api/auth/login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/approvals/{id}/approve for a pending request -> Receive 200 OK and batch expiry date updated
POST /api/auth/login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/approvals/{id}/reject for a pending request -> Receive 200 OK and request marked Rejected

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/approvals/{id}/approve for a non-pending request or without manager role -> Receive 403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found

features.name: Categories API
features.description: Provides category management for packaging or chemical classifications.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/categories with token -> Receive 200 with category list
POST /api/auth/login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/categories with valid category data -> Receive 201 Created
POST /api/auth/login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/categories with invalid payload -> Receive 400 Bad Request
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/categories without a valid token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Contacts API
features.description: Maintains directories of suppliers and laboratory recipients used for warehouse and delivery operations.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/contacts with token -> Receive 200 with contact list
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/contacts with valid supplier or client contact data -> Receive 201 Created
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/contacts with invalid payload -> Receive 400 Bad Request
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/contacts without a valid token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: System Audit Logs API
features.description: Exposes security audit trail queries for review and investigation of system activity.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/audit-log with pagination and filters -> Receive 200 with audit log results
POST /api/auth/login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/audit-log/{id} with existing log ID -> Receive 200 with audit log details
POST /api/auth/login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/audit-log with invalid pagination or filter values -> Receive 400 Bad Request
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/audit-log without admin authorization -> Receive 403 Forbidden
